experimentalDesign: 2x2 Full Factorial Evaluation across 100 holdout offers

configA_previousCode_originalLabels.description: Initial benchmark baseline before forensic audit and fixes

configB_updatedCode_originalLabels.description: Engine improvements evaluated against uncorrected reference labels

configC_previousCode_auditedLabels.description: Previous extraction engine evaluated against evidence-backed ground truth

configD_updatedCode_auditedLabels.description: Production candidate engine evaluated against evidence-backed ground truth

codeImprovementMainEffect.explanation: Genuine production extraction enhancement resulting from suburban dictionary expansion, landmark venue separation, resort regex refinement, and location city parity.

labelCorrectionMainEffect.explanation: Measurement adjustment from correcting 22 invalid benchmark reference labels (13 fallback pollutions, 6 brand speculations, 2 ignored metadata, 1 landmark omission). Does NOT represent pipeline enhancement.

interactionEffect.explanation: Positive synergy where engine fixes (such as single-city location parity and resort property parsing) align with factually corrected ground truth.

scientificDisclaimer: Correcting benchmark annotations measures factual performance more accurately, but only implementation changes (Config A -> B and Config C -> D) represent genuine software quality improvements.
